0022600142.text: The Thunder (3-0, 1st in the Northwest, 2nd in the West) are on a three-game winning streak and 1-0 on the road as they visit the Dallas Mavericks (1-2, 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, 12th in the West) for their fifth game of the season. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh, and Thomas Sorber, while Dallas is missing Caleb Martin, Dereck Lively II, Naji Marshall, Santi Aldama, and Tarik Biberovic. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won all three games against Dallas in 2025-26, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
